payload.description:
As a household member, I want a computerless worker to leave a waiting turn alone, so that a later computer-capable attempt can execute the pending tool without a second model call.

Feature: Computerless turn

Scenario: A computerless worker does not retry the model on a waiting turn
  Given an empty control plane
  And tenant anthus user ryan has a channel with a named bot Assistant
  And tenant anthus user ryan household computer is stopped
  When user ryan of tenant anthus posts a browser request addressed to bot Assistant
  And a counting computerless worker processes bot Assistant
  And the same waiting turn is delivered to a computerless worker again
  Then the model is called only once
  And the turn remains active
  And the pending computer tool action identifier is unchanged

Not included: Fargate, executing the browser tool, staging or production.
payload.title: A computerless worker does not retry the model on a waiting turn
